licenses.text:
Honoré de Balzac, A Start in Life, translated by Clara Bell.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/honore-de-balzac/a-start-in-life/clara-bell

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Honoré de Balzac, the author, died 1850 or 1851 (Wikidata Q9711, P570 1850-08-18 and 1851-08-19).
- Clara Bell, the translator and annotator, died 1927 (Wikidata Q1091668, P570 1927-01-16).

First publication of the text used: 1901, the English translation by Clara Bell. The French original was published in 1845. The country of first publication of the translation is not stated in the facts. (SE colophon: 'A Start in Life was published in 1845 by Honoré de Balzac. It was translated from French in 1901 by Clara Bell.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the translation was first published in 1901 and the original in 1845, both before 1931, so the text is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement quoted below says the same.
- Country of origin: Two layers, checked separately. Original: French work by Honoré de Balzac (died 1850 or 1851), first published 1845. The author died before 1926, so the original is public domain in every country. Translation (English): the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The translator Clara Bell (died 1927) left the public domain in each of them on 1 January 1998, so the translation is public domain in each. The country of first publication therefore makes no difference.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon of this edition (https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/honore-de-balzac/a-start-in-life/clara-bell): quoted above.
- Wikidata Q9711 (Honoré de Balzac), P570 1850-08-18 and 1851-08-19.
